name: SM_Door_Snow_House_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre of the frame (the leaves are not separate), front on -Y
dresses: house door in its frame, 1.6 x 2.36 m: two plank leaves with strap hinges and a ring, dark timber posts and a projecting lintel
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Frame and both leaves are one mesh, so it cannot swing; it is classed as a prop with a base-centre pivot for that reason. Split the leaves off as door-class assets if it must open. One slab with the plank joints, grain and nails in the textures: the joints are not modelled gaps and the edge of the leaf shows no board ends. Iron straps are plain tapered bars without nail heads; there is no lock or latch. No frame or wall: the opening belongs to the building family.
